# OficinaOS

> Free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted management system for phone repair shops.
> Runs on a PC inside the shop over the LAN — no telemetry, and customer data
> never leaves by default. Optional "Pro" modules (in beta, gated server-side
> via OficinaOS Cloud, no license files) send the data they need to OficinaOS
> servers: customer portal, WhatsApp bot, SMS channel, diagnostics intake, AI
> reports, InvoiceXpress invoicing (Portugal only), online storefront, parts
> wanted board, market prices, multi-shop dashboard and WhatsApp remarketing.
> Windows installer: https://github.com/braindeadpt/OficinaOS/releases/latest/download/oficinaos-install.zip
> Documentation in Portuguese (default), English and Spanish.

## Documentation

- [Full guide (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/): install (Docker/portable), daily use, backups, remote access, Pro modules, pricing, FAQ
- [Full guide (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/): same guide in English
- [Full guide (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/): same guide in Spanish
- [Software for repair shops (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/software-reparacao-telemoveis/): overview page — features, pricing model, privacy, install
- [Software for repair shops (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/software-reparacao-telemoveis/)
- [Software for repair shops (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/software-reparacao-telemoveis/)

## Pro module guides

- [Customer portal (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/portal/): public per-repair link, quote accept/decline, privacy model
- [Customer portal (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/portal/)
- [Customer portal (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/portal/)
- [WhatsApp bot (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/whatsapp/): commands, Meta requirements, setup, limits
- [WhatsApp bot (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/whatsapp/)
- [WhatsApp bot (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/whatsapp/)
- [SMS channel (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/sms/): SMS via a local Android gateway (sms-gate) — setup, bot commands, limits
- [SMS channel (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/sms/)
- [SMS channel (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/sms/)
- [OficinaOS Diag (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/diag/): free Windows USB diagnostic tool — features, requirements, troubleshooting
- [OficinaOS Diag (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/diag/)
- [OficinaOS Diag (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/diag/)
- [Certified invoicing (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/invoicing/): InvoiceXpress documents from sales/repairs — Portugal only; setup, VAT handling, privacy
- [Certified invoicing (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/invoicing/)
- [Certified invoicing (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/invoicing/)
- [Online storefront (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/storefront/): public page with listed catalogue items; customer reservations land in the app's Requests queue
- [Online storefront (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/storefront/)
- [Online storefront (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/storefront/)
- [Parts wanted (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/market/): B2B board between OficinaOS shops to request and offer parts
- [Parts wanted (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/market/)
- [Parts wanted (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/market/)
- [Market prices (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/market-prices/): anonymous price benchmarks (median, ≥3 shops), opt-in sharing
- [Market prices (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/market-prices/)
- [Market prices (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/market-prices/)
- [Multi-shop (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/multi-shop/): owner dashboard with daily totals from every shop
- [Multi-shop (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/multi-shop/)
- [Multi-shop (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/multi-shop/)
- [WhatsApp remarketing (PT)](https://oficinaos.app/docs/remarketing/): automatic Meta-template message to idle, consenting customers
- [WhatsApp remarketing (EN)](https://oficinaos.app/en/docs/remarketing/)
- [WhatsApp remarketing (ES)](https://oficinaos.app/es/docs/remarketing/)

## Customer-facing agent interfaces

- [Customer portal JSON](https://cloud.oficinaos.app/api/portal/): per-repair JSON at `/api/portal/<token>` — the 16-hex token in the tracking URL is the credential; quote replies via POST `…/reply` `{kind:"quote",decision:"approve"|"reject",quoteId}`

## Repositories

- [OficinaOS app](https://github.com/braindeadpt/OficinaOS): the shop app (MIT)
- [oficinaos-cloud](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-cloud): pairing, entitlements, webhook/queue relays
- [oficinaos-diag](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-diag): Windows diagnostic tool (MIT)
- [oficinaos-website](https://github.com/braindeadpt/oficinaos-website): this site
- [Ecosystem map](https://github.com/braindeadpt/OficinaOS/blob/main/docs/ecosystem.md): how the 4 repos interconnect
